notes:
Read the complete markdown conversion, lines 1-203, covering all six PDF pages (printed pp. 1770-1775), including the tables, table notes, Figure 1 caption, and complete references. The paper has no appendix, data/code/materials availability statement, preregistration reference, supplementary-file reference, repository URL, or statement that data are available on request. PDF inspection with PyMuPDF found no URI links on any page and no embedded files; page 6 is the end of the references. The discussion of interaction logging, spaCy scoring, survey instruments, and the platform screenshot describes study methods, not a public data or code release. The form's data_and_code.data_url and code_url are both empty.

All successful repository searches in searches returned HTTP 200. DataCite requests used https://api.datacite.org/dois with query and page[size]=100; Harvard Dataverse used https://dataverse.harvard.edu/api/search with q and per_page=100; OSF used https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/ with filter[title] and page[size]=100; successful Zenodo requests used https://zenodo.org/api/records with q and size=25. Initial Zenodo full-title and Villarreal requests with size=100 returned HTTP 400, with the explicit message that unauthenticated page size cannot exceed 25; both were repeated with size=25 and returned HTTP 200. These are search-parameter failures, not evidence of restricted study data. Counts in searches are the API's total results, not counts of relevant deposits, and repeated identical queries are consolidated.

The exact full title returned zero results in all four repositories. The broad DataCite surname query returned 8232 results (100 records retrieved; not exhaustively reviewed) and the broad Zenodo surname query returned 3507 (25 records reviewed). These broad searches were followed by narrower first-author/topic queries: all 71 DataCite results for Villarreal AND (creativ* OR randomness OR LLM OR Brandimarte OR Sachdeva), all 47 results with the additional creators.name field restriction, and all 36 Zenodo results for the corresponding broad-metadata query were reviewed; the Zenodo results were obtained in two pages of 25 and 11. They concern other authors, other topics, or unrelated mentions of the surname. All 42 Harvard Dataverse surname-search results were reviewed; none matched this study. In particular, the two generic titles 'data base research' (doi:10.7910/DVN/D13LJ3 and doi:10.7910/DVN/UHDRCW) name Walter Capa as author, not this paper's authors. The narrowed Harvard query returned zero.

The short phrase 'LLM Randomness' returned four DataCite records: two versions of Xiangyu Guo's 'The Structural Determinacy of LLM Generation: Active Structure, Convergence Frontiers, and the Misreading of Randomness', 'Beyond the Singular: Revealing the Value of Multiple Generations in Benchmark Evaluation' by Wenbo Zhang, Hengrui Cai and Wenyu Chen, and 'Prompt-Reverse Inconsistency: LLM Self-Inconsistency Beyond Generative Randomness and Prompt Paraphrasing' by Jihyun Janice Ahn and Wenpeng Yin. Zenodo returned the Guo record only. None is this paper or a deposit for S1. DataCite searches for this paper's DOI and the combination Villarreal AND Brandimarte returned zero. OSF title-filter searches for the full title, LLM Randomness, Randomness and Creativity, Villarreal, and Brandimarte returned zero; the surname searches on that specified endpoint search node titles, not contributor identities, so they do not establish that no author-owned OSF project exists.

Publisher/source HTTP checks: https://doi.org/10.1109/mipro70003.2026.11592010 resolved to https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11592010/ and returned HTTP 202 with an empty response body (0 bytes), so no supplementary-data section could be inspected. https://docs.mipro-proceedings.com/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. The named open paper URL, https://docs.mipro-proceedings.com/hci/02_21229_hci.pdf, returned HTTP 200 with content type application/pdf (894547 bytes read in memory). This paper PDF is not counted as a data deposit. No login, account creation, access request, or challenge bypass was attempted.

No relevant data, code, materials, or supplementary deposit was identified, so there was no repository file inventory or participant data file to inspect. For S1, no verified public data currently enable the missing arm means, SDs, SEs, participant-level contrasts, regression analysis counts, round-pooling checks, exclusions by arm, AI-user subsample statistics, or diversity measures from participant texts. what_we_could_compute is therefore null. The result means none found within the documented checks, not proof that the data do not exist or are unavailable privately. Confidence is medium because the publisher landing page could not be inspected, the first author is identified only as A. Villarreal in the paper, and repository metadata/title searches can miss unlinked deposits.
